id: title:Gilbert09:show where to find the app id during setup

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies App ID configuration instructions for AppsFlyer integration, potentially reducing support requests and configuration errors.
review.reason: Replaces a generic error message with specific, actionable instructions including exact location and example formats for iOS and Android App IDs. This is a localized improvement to user-facing guidance.
review.uncertainty: The actual reduction in support requests and configuration errors is not demonstrated by the code, only the improved instruction is. No tier assignment is requested.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are contained within a single PR group. No other PRs are supplied, so no unrelated-PR uncertainty exists. No tier assignment is requested.

observations.behavior: Replaced the AppsFlyer credentials error message with a more specific instruction, including the exact location and example format.
observations.code_quote: caption="In AppsFlyer, open My apps and copy the ID under your app name, such as `id123456789` for iOS or `com.example.app` for Android.",
observations.posthog_connection: Provides clearer user guidance when an app ID is supplied but not recognized, potentially reducing support requests and configuration errors.
